summary: The booking surfaces obey the contract; the automation path does not, and the two disagree. CORRECT SIDE: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299-302 calls shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent, apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199-202 calls shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent over a select that fetches both team.hideBranding and parent.hideBranding (lines 232-239), apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61-64 and :103-106, apps/web/lib/org/[orgSlug]/instant-meeting/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:85-88, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36-39, apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-258 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58-62 all route through the event-scoped resolvers in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:85-181, which apply the organization override at :40-42 and :96-104. WRONG SOURCE, THREE DISTINCT WAYS. (1) packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 resolves the flag with getHideBranding({ userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId }) — the WORKFLOW's own owner, not the owner of the event type the booking belongs to; a workflow owned by a user but active on a team event (or the reverse) resolves against an entity unrelated to what the attendee booked. The value then flows to :103, :148, :233, :244 and into customTemplate at :486-492. packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 does the same for form-triggered workflows using form.userId/form.teamId, forwarding at :145 and :169. (2) packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, :274-276 and :433-435 bypass the resolver entirely, computing brandingDisabled as reminder.booking.eventType?.team?.hideBranding : reminder.booking.user?.hideBranding — the raw column with NO organization override, so an org that disabled branding still emits it; packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:195-203 makes this unfixable in place by selecting only team { parentId, hideBranding }, never parent.hideBranding. (3) The booking callers that seed the scheduler pass !!eventType?.owner?.hideBranding — owner-only, so a TEAM event whose owner is null yields false and branding is shown: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618, :2793, :2808; packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459, :472; packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:112; packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377; packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230; packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:561; packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671; packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188. The flag is then carried untouched through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56, :97, :161, :213, :248, :262, :280, emailReminderManager.ts:38, :115, :147, :182, :204, scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18-27, :82 and packages/features/tasker/tasks/triggerFormSubmittedNoEvent/triggerFormSubmittedNoEventWorkflow.ts:29, :41, :66, and is finally what stamps the vendor name into the attendee's message at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/customTemplate.ts:216, emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-83 and emailRatingTemplate.ts:79-80. The owning repositories that the resolver depends on are packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:462-473 and packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1336; the plan gate is apps/web/lib/isBrandingHidden.tsx:1-3; the per-event brand identity sibling is packages/features/profile/lib/getBranding.ts.
